strings.EQUIPMENT_RDAS_RECYCLER_DESC: <style=cIsUtility>Recycles</style> a targeted Item into two Items of a <style=cIsUtility>lesser tier</style>.
strings.CURSEDBOOK_SPELL_RDAS_DARKALCHEMY_DESC: <style=cIsUtility>Transmute</style> an Item or Equipment into a different one. <style=cStack>Can only be converted into the same tier one time.</style>
